name: Self-Employment / Business Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: A personal work permit for self-employment requires EUR 10,000 in personal financial resources, plus ownership or rental of business premises. Processing takes 30-60 days, costs roughly EUR 90, and the permit is issued for 1 year, renewable.
requirements.fix_path: Register as self-employed in Slovenia, document EUR 10,000 in personal financial resources and business premises, and apply for the personal work permit.

requirement_groups.name: Work permit for foreign company representative

requirements.blocker_text: A work permit for a foreign company's representative requires a EUR 30,000 investment if the Slovenian company has been registered for less than 6 months. The permit runs up to 2 years and can be extended.
requirements.fix_path: Register or invest in a Slovenian company (EUR 30,000 if registered under 6 months) and apply for the representative work permit.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial resources or company investment

outcome.duration_length: 1 year (self-employment, renewable) or up to 2 years (foreign representative, extendable)

sources.title: SPOT (Slovenska poslovna tocka, Slovenia's government business portal) -- self-employment personal work permit (EUR 10,000) and foreign-representative work permit (EUR 30,000) requirements and durations

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovenia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- both hard requirements sourced directly to spot.gov.si, Slovenia's own government business portal, tier 1 (the page itself notes some content 'is still being edited', disclosed for transparency though the cited figures are stated plainly). Two genuinely distinct thresholds modeled as alternative paths: a comparatively modest EUR 10,000 personal-resources bar for self-employment versus a EUR 30,000 investment bar for representing an under-6-month-old foreign company -- both far lower than typical 'golden visa' investor thresholds seen elsewhere in this dataset. pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months mirror the general Slovenian residence-to-PR and PR-to-citizenship rules (see si_citizenship_naturalisation.json), not independently confirmed as applying automatically from these specific permits.
